verdict.line: You lose if you let him hit max-range Shock Blasts through Acceleration Gate for free; you win if you punish his Hammer-Stance all-ins with Parrrley poke and Grasp procs.

brief.thesis: This is an even matchup decided by stance-reading: Jayce is dangerous in Hammer Stance (To the Skies!, Thundering Blow) up close and dangerous in Cannon Stance (Shock Blast, Acceleration Gate) at range, but he can only be one at a time. Gangplank's Q (Parrrley) has a 625 range and 5s cooldown, letting you poke him every time he's forced into melee range to farm or trade, while his Passive (Grog-Soaked Blade) poison adds up over a long fight. The 52.7% win rate over 3,306 games confirms this is winnable on mechanics, not free.

theirWindow.when: Hammer Stance and E off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He can leap in with Q (To the Skies!), knock you back with E (Thundering Blow, 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown), and transform R into Mercury Cannon for extra range. Respect the knockback into your minions and don't facecheck brush when his E is up.

yourWindow.when: He's in Hammer Stance near minions
yourWindow.what: Walk up and fire Q (Parrrley, 5s cooldown, 625 range) into his face repeatedly — he has no ranged poke in this stance, so you out-trade him every single time his Q and E are down.

runes.keystoneWhy: The burn stacks every time you land Parrrley, matching OP.GG's own read: stack Grasp-style pressure with Q to control lane, and Deathfire's DoT compounds with your Grog-Soaked Blade poison.

summoners.why: 86.8% pick rate at 53.1% win — Ignite punishes his low-sustain all-ins and secures early kills off your Q poke.

playing.title: Track his stance before trading
playing.detail: Hammer Stance means melee leap/knockback threat; Cannon Stance means ranged Shock Blast threat. Never trade as if both are live at once.

playing.title: Punish Hammer Stance with Parrrley
playing.detail: While he's in Hammer Stance he has zero ranged poke, so walk up and fire Q (5s cooldown, 625 range) repeatedly to win the exchange.

playing.title: Respect E knockback near walls
playing.detail: His E (Thundering Blow, 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown) knocks you back — don't stand where that throws you into his minions or towards his jungler.

playing.title: Save W for CC and burst windows
playing.detail: W (Remove Scurvy) clears any crowd control and heals you, so hold it through his E knockback or an incoming gank rather than using it on cooldown.

playing.title: Use R to punish his all-in commit
playing.detail: Cannon Barrage (120/115/110/120/120s cooldown) can be dropped on your own position when he dives, since the slow and DoT swing extended trades back to you.

playing.title: Skill order EQWQQRQEQ
playing.detail: 57.3% win rate order prioritizes Q for poke uptime and only grabs single points of W/E early, matching the plan of winning through repeated Parrrley trades rather than all-ins.

playing.title: Don't chase into Cannon Stance
playing.detail: If he swaps to Cannon Stance and backs up, he gets Hextech Capacitor move speed from the swap — don't burn Flash chasing a poke he can kite for free.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (16.19.1); the stance-tracking and trade-timing read is my own tactical judgement.

stats.opponentTip: Stack up on Grasp of the Undying whenever it comes off cooldown with [Q] to gain control over lane. As he will get a kill as he gains items appropriately, focus on avoiding his skills.
